subject: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Hi Laura + Priya,

We’re ready for stakeholder sign-off on the Console UX for the internal unit economics dashboard (blended $/1M output tokens). This is the last UX checkpoint before we lock the scope for the internal beta rollout behind the feature flag.

Mocks (v3): https://figma.com/file/RWDX/unit-econ-dashboard-v3 (internal)

What we need from you both:
1) Finance (Laura/Rishi): confirm the framing + definition surfaces are correct for weekly reporting (esp. what we show in the metric definition tooltip + the “Included/Excluded” panel).
2) Platform (Priya/Logan): confirm the drilldown + filter model aligns with the supported dimensions / cardinality guardrails (model/region/tier, plus optional quantization_profile + runtime_config behind “Advanced”).

Key UX decisions in v3:
- Default landing is “Blended cost ($/1M output tokens) — last 30 days” with top-level filters: Model, Region, Tier.
- Advanced filters are collapsed by default (quantization_profile, runtime_config, cache_profile) with explicit warning that not all slices are available historically.
- Data health banner: shows freshness + last successful reconciliation timestamp; links to the data quality SLO page.
- “Explain delta” panel (DES-212) is included in MVP but initially limited to mix-shift attribution (model mix, region mix, tier mix) + cache hit-rate deltas; runtime changes link out to rollouts.

Open questions (please call out in your reply):
- Restricted views: we currently show “gross” blended cost in the main view and gate “net of discounts/credits” under a Finance-only toggle. Is that the right split?
- Export: Finance asked for CSV export. Current design exports whatever slice is on-screen (with the metric definition included in the header).

Requested timeline:
- Please reply with “Approved” or concrete changes by EOD Wed 2/5.
- If we need a live review, Talia can set up a 25-min slot Tue/Wed.

References:
- ADR (canonical definition + reconciliation approach): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/ADR-0142
- PRD: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Internal+Unit+Economics+Dashboard+PRD
- Epic: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PM-482

Thanks,
Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference


From: Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 10:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Adding a quick pointer to what changed since v2:
- The definition tooltip now has a “Show formula” expander + a link to ADR-0142.
- “Included/Excluded” panel uses Finance language (compute + overhead allocation included; training + one-time backfills excluded).
- Data freshness badge is now persistent in the header (not just a banner).

If anyone wants, I can walk through in 10 mins async via Loom too.

Alicia


From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 2:21 PM PT
Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Platform POV: v3 looks aligned with what we can support without blowing up cardinality.

Two notes:
1) Advanced filters: quantization_profile is fine, but runtime_config needs to be constrained to a small allowlist (e.g., “default”, “throughput”, “low_latency”) vs raw config hashes. If the UI expects free-form values we’ll get a lot of empty states.
2) The “Explain delta” panel should clearly label when attribution is partial (e.g., late events excluded; reconciliation not complete for last 24h). The banner helps, but the panel itself should show a mini disclaimer.

Otherwise +1.

Logan


From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 4, 2025 at 9:08 AM PT
Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Agree with Logan’s notes.

One more request from me: for the default view, can we avoid showing “All models” as the initial selection and instead default to “Top 10 by output tokens” with an option to expand? That keeps the query patterns sane, and it nudges folks toward interpretable slices.

If Product prefers “All models” for narrative reasons, we need a hard limit + a message when the result set is truncated.

Priya


From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 5, 2025 at 11:47 AM PT
Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Finance notes (reviewed with Laura briefly):

1) Definitions:
- Please ensure the tooltip explicitly states this is “blended COGS-style cost allocated to inference requests” and that it includes overhead allocation per ADR.
- We should not show “net of discounts/credits” to most users. Gating it behind Finance-only is correct. In the non-Finance view, please avoid any “toggle tease” that implies there’s a hidden number—just label it as “Gross blended cost” and keep “Net” out of sight unless you have access.

2) Exclusions:
- Clarify how we treat one-time credits granted as incident remediation. (My preference: included in net, excluded from gross; but net view is gated anyway.)

3) Export:
- CSV export is good. Please include: date, model, region, tier, output_tokens, blended_cost_usd, blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens, cache_hit_rate (if present), and a “data_complete” flag.

If we incorporate the above, I’m comfortable.

Rishi


From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 6, 2025 at 4:38 PM PT
Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Approved with the changes Rishi and Priya/Logan called out.

Marissa — can you send a quick note when those are incorporated and we’ll treat that as final sign-off.

Separately (not a blocker for MVP): I’d like the weekly review view to have a “This week vs last week” snapshot that’s stable and doesn’t change based on a user’s last-selected filters. We can discuss once the beta is live.

Laura

—
Laura Bennett
CFO
Redwood Inference


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 6, 2025 at 5:12 PM PT
Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard UX review + sign-off (Finance + Platform) — mocks v3

Thanks all — we’ll incorporate:
- Allowlisted runtime_config values only (no raw hashes) + clearer empty-state copy.
- “Explain delta” disclaimer when attribution is partial / last 24h not complete.
- Default query behavior: we’ll implement Priya’s “Top 10 by output tokens” default with an expand option + a hard limit message if users select “All models.”
- Finance gating: remove any visible “Net” affordance unless user has Finance role; default label will be “Gross blended cost.”
- CSV columns + data_complete flag per Rishi.

Talia + I will update DES-211/DES-212 with these decisions and aim to have v3.1 ready for final glance by Mon 2/10.

Marissa
